svg.title: Plate 3, who changes what: you write pages as ordinary data; the runtime is a small fixed write path and a short list of general primitives; connectors, derived data, keys and secrets sit beside the vault. Three laws on nested membranes: reach flows down, rules only tighten downwards, spending is conserved downwards.
